title: DeepSomatic: a neural network for somatic variants in tumors
summary: For insertions and deletions, it reaches 90% with Illumina data versus 80% for the best other tool, and over 80% with PacBio versus under 50%. In eight pediatric leukemia samples, it recovered known variants and flagged ten new ones that have not been independently validated. The tool and CASTLE dataset are open.

evidence.tested: DeepSomatic was benchmarked against SomaticSniper, MuTect2, Strelka2 and ClairS on the CASTLE cell-line dataset with held-out chromosomes and genomes, across Illumina, PacBio and other platforms.
evidence.unknown: The benchmark uses research cell lines rather than patient tumors, the glioblastoma result rests on one sample, and the 10 new leukemia variants are not stated to be validated.
evidence.ai_role: A convolutional neural network applied to sequencing data converted to images separated germline, somatic and error signals to call tumor variants.
